description:
Search tourist spots in Japan by keyword, prefecture and category.
観光スポットを検索する。キーワード、都道府県、カテゴリで絞り込み可能。

category.description: Spot category key(s), comma separated. See list_spot_categories (e.g. nature_mountain, culture_shrine_temple)

keyword.description: Keyword matched against spot name/address (Japanese, e.g. "温泉", "城")

prefecture.description: Prefecture in English or Japanese (e.g. "Tokyo", "Kyoto", "東京都")

name: search_spots
title: Search tourist spots
